figures.caption: Figure 1: Numerical illustrations. Row 1: ATE estimator distribution under each copula DGP. Rows 2–3: imputed treatment effect distributions across stickiness levels 𝜌 under the Bregman-Sinkhorn copula DGP (row 2) and Gaussian copula DGP (row 3).

Figure 2: Variance bounds of the ATE: V̂arFH, V̂arN versus V̂arSB by varying the stickiness parameter 𝜌 ∈ {0.9, 0.95, 0.99}, under the Bregman–Sinkhorn copula DGP (left) and the Gaussian copula DGP (right). The top row visualizes the copula DGPs and rank violations by plotting the unobserved (𝑌0, 𝑌1) pairs. The bottom row compares the variance bounds against the true variance across 500 independent draws of 𝑇 .
